# Profile

Bioinformatician working where virology meets genomics. I design and maintain
reproducible pipelines that turn public sequencing data into biological insight,
from raw NGS reads to curated viral genomes and interactive reports. My work
spans viral discovery and surveillance, metatranscriptomics, small RNAs and
plant immunity, built on R, Python, Bash and Nextflow running on Linux HPC
(SLURM) and cloud environments. Currently also pursuing a BSc in Computer
Science, focused on data science and the optimization
of algorithms and pipelines. I care about open, well-documented software: the
viruses are already in the data, and my job is to make finding them routine.

# Experience

::: {.entry title="PhD Researcher — Bioinformatics & Viral Genomics" org="Biotechnology and Genetics Center, UESC" location="Ilhéus, BA" date="2025 — Present"}
- Lead the full refactor of **ViralQuest** (Python ≥ 3.12, pixi), improving dependency installation, Apple silicon support and the interactive HTML report.
- Build automated NGS workflows in Python, Bash and Nextflow for Linux HPC (SLURM) and AWS.
- Extend viral discovery to new hosts and datasets mined from public sequence repositories.
:::

::: {.entry title="Public Health Data Analyst & R Shiny Developer" org="UESC · Regional Health Authorities" location="Bahia" date="2025 — 2026"}
- Developed R Shiny dashboards that integrated disease notification data (SINAN) for public health teams.
- Automated reporting pipelines; deployed with bslib, shinymanager, renv and Docker for secure, reproducible releases.
:::

::: {.entry title="MSc Researcher — Viral Genomics & Transcriptomics" org="Biotechnology and Genetics Center, UESC" location="Ilhéus, BA" date="2023 — 2025"}
- Mined public RNA-Seq libraries of *Theobroma cacao* for viral discovery and genomic surveillance.
- Performed bulk RNA-Seq analysis (assembly, differential expression, enrichment) with R/Bioconductor.
- Created the first release of ViralQuest and co-authored studies on viromes, EVEs and bee miRNAs.
:::

# Selected Projects

::: {.entry title="ViralQuest" org="Creator & lead developer" link="https://github.com/gabrielvpina/viralquest" date="Python · PyPI" tags="Python, Bioinformatics, NGS Pipelines, Data Visualization, D3.js"}
Interactive, accessible pipeline for viral sequence discovery, annotation and curation,
with a D3.js HTML report for end users. Published in *BMC Bioinformatics* (2026).
:::

::: {.entry title="viralfetch & slin" org="Open-source command-line tools" link="https://github.com/gabrielvpina" date="Python · TUI" tags="Python, CLI & TUI, SLURM, HPC, Data Retrieval"}
**viralfetch** queries and downloads viral taxonomy, metadata and sequences;
**slin** is a terminal interface for the SLURM workload manager.
:::

::: {.entry title="Open science & technical writing" org="gabrielvpina.github.io · dataViz · quartoTemplates" link="https://gabrielvpina.github.io" date="R · Quarto" tags="Tutorials, Data Science, Machine Learning, Phylogenetics, Quarto"}
